integrity: Proof uses established boundary Green function and an independently derived Toeplitz/Dirichlet variational inequality; numerical tests complement but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Continuous-time coinless quantum walk with one Lindblad boundary sink; coherent finite-window packets, asymptotic eventual absorption with an explicit uniform distance error. Finite-time, interactions, multiple sinks and measurement noise are outside scope.
title: A sharp coherence-length law for boundary absorption of quantum walkers
